info.name: Timetable Admin API
info.description: Checkpoint C: health, authentication, stations, staff, simulator camera ingest and station-scoped alerts are implemented. Analytics and audit listing remain draft. Run npm run postman:admin or npm run postman:camera for isolated real HTTP workflows. Do not run the full Collection: draft requests remain.

request.description: Liveness API tanpa query database. Memeriksa status, JSON, response body, dan security header.

exec: pm.test("Liveness response sesuai kontrak", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({success: true, data: {status: 'ok'}}));

request.description: Memeriksa koneksi PostgreSQL melalui query SELECT 1. HTTP 503 bila database tidak tersedia.
Implemented. Opaque admin_session cookie is managed by Postman; data.csrfToken is captured automatically. Accounts with mustChangePassword=true can only access me/change-password/logout.

exec: pm.test("One station and fixed security role", () => { const u = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(u.role).to.eql("STATION_SECURITY"); pm.expect(u.stationId).to.eql(pm.environment.get("managedStationId")); });

request.description: Implemented in Checkpoint B. Use fixture/demo data only.
Implemented in Checkpoint B. Use fixture/demo data only.
Simulator development/test only. Requires X-Ingest-Key. Generates a fresh UUID and timestamp; confirms the selected active station. No mobile integration is enabled.
Send immediately after Create Camera Session. Identical UUID/payload returns the same session without creating another row. Requests older than 5 minutes must start a new session.
Accepted failure increments the consecutive counter; no alert yet.
Accepted failure increments the consecutive counter; no alert yet.
Third consecutive analysis failure creates exactly one alert. The alert UUID is saved automatically.
Jalankan setelah 10, dalam 5 menit. Mengirim payload identik. Verifikasi hanya ada satu alert di daftar; status sukses saja belum membuktikan idempotency.
Paginated list scoped on the server to the current station. Personal name/phone are returned only by authorized alert detail.
Gunakan alert NEW. Mengubah NEW menjadi ACKNOWLEDGED.

exec: pm.test("Claimed by current account", () => { const d=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.status).to.eql("ACKNOWLEDGED"); pm.expect(d.assignedToId).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty; });

request.description: Requires ACKNOWLEDGED status and nonblank notes (1-1000 characters). Only the assigned handler or Super Admin may resolve.

exec: pm.test("Resolved with note", () => { const d=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.status).to.eql("RESOLVED"); pm.expect(d.resolutionNote).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty; });
